name: campus board double dyno
description: A campus board move where both hands leave a rung together and catch another rung at the same time. It is advanced work for explosive pulling power and for gripping a rung hard the moment you land on it.
instructions: Hang from a low rung with both hands in the same grip and your arms slightly bent.
Drop a little to load your arms, then pull hard and let go with both hands at once.
Catch the next rung up with both hands at the same time.
Absorb the catch with bent arms and engaged shoulders.
Move up or down one rung at a time, keeping every catch controlled.
End the set when a catch gets sloppy and rest fully between sets.
